changelog:
Version 2.0.0 of xiaozhi-teach-renewal-report is a major upgrade, transforming renewal communication into a professional, data-driven service based on student learning profiles.

- Introduces a structured, "facts + progress + plan" three-part report to anchor renewal discussions in objective data and proven student growth.
- Automates integration with lesson logs, student analyzers, dashboards, and parent communication modules for seamless data flow.
- Adds multiple report trigger points (mid-term, renewal, end-term, milestones, parent inquiry) improving timing and relevance.
- Implements advanced progress visualization (comparative tables, heatmaps, timelines) for clear, compelling parent communication.
- Clarifies strict boundaries: no score promises, no exaggerated data, no auto-sending—empowering teachers to make informed, service-oriented recommendations.
- Includes templates and scripts, supporting every stage from data collection to personalized renewal talk tracks.
